document.name: Pending Purchase
document.query:
SELECT
  'Awaiting Delivery' AS stage,
  poi.material_request AS material_request,
  mr.transaction_date AS mr_date,
  po.name AS purchase_order,
  po.transaction_date AS po_date,
  po.supplier AS supplier,
  poi.item_code AS item_code,
  poi.item_name AS item_name,
  poi.item_group AS item_group,
  poi.qty AS qty,
  (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END) AS done_qty,
  (poi.qty - (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END)) AS pending_qty,
  poi.uom AS uom,
  poi.base_rate AS rate,
  ROUND((poi.qty - (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END)) * poi.base_rate, 2) AS pending_value,
  poi.schedule_date AS required_by,
  CASE WHEN poi.schedule_date < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), poi.schedule_date) ELSE 0 END AS days_overdue,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN 'UOM/Item lineage review required' ELSE po.status END AS status,
  poi.warehouse AS warehouse,
  po.currency AS po_currency
FROM `tabPurchase Order` po
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
  ON poi.parent = po.name AND poi.parenttype = 'Purchase Order'
LEFT JOIN `tabMaterial Request` mr ON mr.name = poi.material_request
WHERE po.docstatus = 1
  AND po.status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Completed', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled', 'On Hold', 'Stopped')
  AND ((COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) OR (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END) < poi.qty)
  AND %(stage)s IN ('All', 'Awaiting Delivery')
  AND (CASE WHEN %(based_on)s = 'Required By Date' THEN poi.schedule_date ELSE po.transaction_date END)
      BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Awaiting PO',
  mr.name,
  mr.transaction_date,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  mri.item_code,
  mri.item_name,
  mri.item_group,
  mri.stock_qty,
  mri.ordered_qty,
  (mri.stock_qty - mri.ordered_qty),
  mri.stock_uom,
  IFNULL(it.last_purchase_rate, 0),
  ROUND((mri.stock_qty - mri.ordered_qty) * IFNULL(it.last_purchase_rate, 0), 2),
  mri.schedule_date,
  CASE WHEN mri.schedule_date < CURDATE() THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), mri.schedule_date) ELSE 0 END,
  mr.status,
  mri.warehouse,
  NULL
FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
INNER JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mri
  ON mri.parent = mr.name AND mri.parenttype = 'Material Request'
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` it ON it.name = mri.item_code
WHERE mr.docstatus = 1
  AND mr.material_request_type = 'Purchase'
  AND mr.status NOT IN ('Stopped', 'Cancelled')
  AND mri.ordered_qty < mri.stock_qty
  AND %(stage)s IN ('All', 'Awaiting PO')
  AND (CASE WHEN %(based_on)s = 'Required By Date' THEN mri.schedule_date ELSE mr.transaction_date END)
      BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

ORDER BY required_by ASC, stage ASC, purchase_order ASC, material_request ASC

document.name: Purchase MIS - Open Items
document.query:
SELECT 'PO' AS kind, po.name AS doc, po.supplier AS party, po.transaction_date AS d1, poi.schedule_date AS d2,
  (poi.qty - (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END)) AS qty,
  (poi.qty - (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END)) * poi.base_rate AS v1,
  (poi.qty - (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END)) * poi.base_rate AS v2,
  (CASE WHEN (po.currency <> 'INR' AND po.conversion_rate <= 1.01) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flag,
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN 'UOM/Item lineage review required' ELSE po.currency END AS info
FROM `tabPurchase Order` po
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi ON poi.parent = po.name AND poi.parenttype = 'Purchase Order'

WHERE po.docstatus = 1 AND po.status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Completed', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled', 'On Hold', 'Stopped') AND ((COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) OR (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(poi.conversion_factor,1)<0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
 JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name
 AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0 AND (pri.item_code<>poi.item_code OR
 COALESCE(pri.stock_uom,'')<>COALESCE(poi.stock_uom,'') OR COALESCE(pri.conversion_factor,1)<0))) THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.received_qty,0),pri.qty) * COALESCE(NULLIF(pri.conversion_factor,0),1))
 FROM `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` prx ON prx.name=pri.parent
 WHERE pri.purchase_order_item=poi.name AND prx.docstatus=1 AND prx.is_return=0),0)
 / COALESCE(NULLIF(poi.conversion_factor,0),1),6) END) < poi.qty)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MR', mr.name, mri.item_code, mr.transaction_date, mri.schedule_date,
  (mri.stock_qty - mri.ordered_qty),
  (mri.stock_qty - mri.ordered_qty) * IFNULL((SELECT i.base_rate / (CASE WHEN i.conversion_factor > 0 THEN i.conversion_factor ELSE 1 END)
      FROM `tabPurchase Order Item` i INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order` p ON p.name = i.parent 
      WHERE i.item_code = mri.item_code AND p.docstatus = 1 ORDER BY p.transaction_date DESC, p.creation DESC LIMIT 1), IFNULL(it.last_purchase_rate, 0)),
  0,
  (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabRequest for Quotation Item` rq INNER JOIN `tabRequest for Quotation` r ON r.name = rq.parent WHERE rq.material_request = mr.name AND r.docstatus < 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  mr.status
FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
INNER JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mri ON mri.parent = mr.name AND mri.parenttype = 'Material Request'
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` it ON it.name = mri.item_code
WHERE mr.docstatus = 1 AND mr.material_request_type = 'Purchase' AND mr.status NOT IN ('Stopped', 'Cancelled') AND mri.ordered_qty < mri.stock_qty
UNION ALL
SELECT 'GRN', pr.name, pr.supplier, pr.posting_date, NULL, 0,
  pr.base_grand_total * GREATEST(0,1-COALESCE(pr.per_billed,0)/100),
  pr.base_grand_total, (CASE WHEN (pr.currency <> 'INR' AND pr.conversion_rate <= 1.01) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), pr.currency
FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr 
WHERE pr.docstatus = 1 AND pr.is_return=0 AND pr.status IN ('To Bill','Partly Billed') AND COALESCE(pr.per_billed,0)<100
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PI', pi.name, pi.supplier, pi.posting_date, NULL, 0, pi.base_grand_total, pi.base_grand_total, 0, pi.currency
FROM `tabPurchase Invoice` pi WHERE pi.docstatus = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'QC', qi.name, qi.item_code, qi.report_date, NULL, 0, 0, 0, qi.docstatus, qi.status
FROM `tabQuality Inspection` qi WHERE qi.docstatus < 2 AND qi.inspection_type = 'Incoming' AND qi.status = 'Review Required'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PCA', pca.name, pca.supplier, DATE(pca.creation), NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, IFNULL(pca.approval_status, '')
FROM `tabPurchase Commercial Approval` pca WHERE pca.docstatus<2 AND pca.approval_status IN ('Draft','Reopened') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSupplier Quotation` sq WHERE sq.name=pca.supplier_quotation AND sq.docstatus=1 AND sq.status<>'Cancelled')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RIV', 'all', '', NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN riv.creation < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0, 0, ''
FROM `tabRM Inward Validation` riv WHERE riv.status = 'Pending QC'

document.name: Purchase MIS - Performance
document.query:
SELECT 'GRN' AS kind, pr.supplier AS party, pr.name AS doc, pr.posting_date AS d1, poi.schedule_date AS d2, po.transaction_date AS d3,
  pri.base_amount AS v1,
  pri.qty AS v2, 0 AS v3, 0 AS v4, pri.item_code AS item, '' AS info, '' AS info2, '' AS info3
FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri ON pri.parent = pr.name AND pri.parenttype = 'Purchase Receipt'
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi ON poi.name = pri.purchase_order_item
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po ON po.name = poi.parent

WHERE pr.docstatus = 1 AND pr.is_return = 0 AND pr.posting_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL %(days)s DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'QI', pr.supplier, qi.name, qi.report_date, NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, qi.item_code, qi.status, '', ''
FROM `tabQuality Inspection` qi
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt` pr ON pr.name = qi.reference_name AND qi.reference_type = 'Purchase Receipt'
WHERE qi.docstatus = 1 AND qi.inspection_type = 'Incoming' AND qi.report_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL %(days)s DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DEC', d.custom_supplier, d.name, DATE(d.creation), NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 0, 0, d.item_code, d.decision, '', ''
FROM `tabRM QC Decision` d WHERE d.docstatus < 2 AND d.creation >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL %(days)s DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PCA', pca.supplier, pca.name, DATE(pca.creation), NULL, NULL, pca.benchmark_rate, pca.quoted_rate, pca.qty, pca.variance_percent,
  pca.item_code, IFNULL(pca.approval_status, ''), IFNULL(pca.reason_for_higher_price, ''), IFNULL(pca.item_name, '')
FROM `tabPurchase Commercial Approval` pca WHERE pca.docstatus<2 AND pca.creation >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL %(days)s DAY)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'RATE', po.supplier, po.name, po.transaction_date, NULL, NULL, poi.base_rate, poi.qty, poi.base_amount, poi.conversion_factor,
  poi.item_code, po.currency, '', IFNULL(poi.item_name, '')
FROM `tabPurchase Order` po
INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi ON poi.parent = po.name AND poi.parenttype = 'Purchase Order'
WHERE po.docstatus = 1 AND po.currency = 'INR'
  AND po.transaction_date >= DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY), INTERVAL 2 MONTH)
